verdict.rationale: Pika lists a first-party 'Talking Head Video: Make a virtual spokesperson' app, which is the core of this story. It also offers reusable custom characters and voiceover (Eleven Multilingual v2, 'Add VO for social'), which together suggest a presenter video built from a custom persona without a camera. The evidence is only one-line listings, though, and it never shows script-to-video input or a stock avatar library. missing for 10: explicit paste-a-script workflow, documented stock avatar library, confirmation that custom characters work as talking-head presenters, lip-sync/presenter quality details, independent or hands-on corroboration
